messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm multi-year commitment for the full seal volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You told us you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and the attached term sheets offer exactly that: our full annual need under a binding multi-year contract.

Our should-cost estimate cost:340010 puts the unit cost at 24.31 EUR.
Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, so the commitment rests on growing demand.
Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5%, so a fixed allocation with a dependable lead time matters to us.

Because the price change exceeds 2%, could you please put these sheets to your pricing committee? Please also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm multi-year commitment for the full seal volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your should-cost estimate does not capture the complexity of our specialized manufacturing. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept the 36-month contract and increased volume, which allows us to offer a revised price of 31.90 EUR. To support this price, we must maintain the 54-day lead time, as a reduction to 42 days is not feasible under our current load. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit, with a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
